_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your keys. config.json is gitignored and must never be committed.
_models_note: MODEL writes, reviews and judges; MODEL_FAST does extraction. Any OpenAI model (gpt-...) or Claude model (claude-...). Prices per 1M tokens in/out: gpt-6.1-sol $2/$10, claude-sonnet-5-5 $2/$10, claude-opus-5-5 $4/$20; fast: gpt-6-luna or claude-haiku-5-5 $0.10/$0.50. Run tools/benchmark.py to compare on your own resumes before choosing.
_smtp_note: SMTP is OPTIONAL. Only needed for the Job Alerts email feature. Leave blank to disable. For Gmail use an App Password, not your account password.
